relations.subject: Karen McCarthy Brown
relations.evidence: She began her doctoral work in 1970, graduating from Temple University in 1976. Her dissertation was titled "The Veve of Haitian Vodou: A Structural Analysis of Visual Imagery."

relations.subject: Karen McCarthy Brown
relations.evidence: Until her retirement in 2009 due to illness, McCarthy Brown was a professor of anthropology at Drew University.
